about.title: Ukwakha Izixazululo Zedijithali Eziyisa Amabhizinisi Phambili
about.description:
I-Oklut Technologies inkampani yezixazululo zobuchwepheshe egxile ekusizeni amabhizinisi ukuguqula imibono ibe okuhlangenwe nakho kwedijithali okunenjongo. Sihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhlakani, nokuqonda kwebhizinisi ukuze kulethe izixazululo eziklanywe ngokwezidingo zomhlaba wangempela.

Kusukela ekuguqulweni kwedijithali nokuthuthukiswa kwesofthiwe yangokwezifiso kuye kumafu, i-AI, i-automation, namasevisi obuchwepheshe aphethwe, sisiza izinhlangano zenze inkimbinkimbi zibe lula, zithuthukise ukusebenza kahle, futhi zidale inani elihlala njalo ledijithali.

Indlela yethu ilula — qonda izinkinga, futhi wakhe ubuchwepheshe obunjalo.
about.awardText: Kuqashelwa ukulethwa okuhle kakhulu kuyo yonke iwebhu nobunjiniyela bomkhiqizo weselula.
about.staffText: Onjiniyela abakhulu, abaziphendulelayo abangabanikazi bomsebenzi kusukela ocingweni lokuqala ukuya bukhoma.
about.supportText: Amasevisi aphethwe kanye nolayini wokusekela ophendulayo uma uwudinga.

section1.title: 1. Ulwazi Esiluqoqayo
body: Siqoqa ulwazi olunikeza ngokuqondile (njengegama lakho nekheli le-imeyili uma uthumela ifomu lokuxhumana noma udala i-akhawunti) kanye nolwazi oluqoqwe ngokuzenzakalelayo ngamakhukhi nobuchwepheshe obufanayo, njengamakhasi avakashelwe, uhlobo lwedivayisi kanye nendawo eseduze.

section2.title: 2. Siwasebenzisa Kanjani Amakhukhi
body: Amakhukhi abalulekile ahlala enikwe amandla ngoba iwebhusayithi ayikwazi ukusebenza kahle ngaphandle kwawo. Bagcina isikhathi kanye nesimo sokuqinisekisa futhi bakhumbule okuncamelayo kwekhukhi.

Amakhukhi ezibalo asisiza ukuthi siqonde ukuthi izivakashi zilisebenzisa kanjani isayithi ukuze sikwazi ukulithuthukisa. Amakhukhi wokumaketha asetshenziselwa ukukubonisa izipesheli nemikhankaso efanele. Lezi zigaba zinikwa amandla ngemvume yakho kuphela futhi zingashintshwa noma nini kuphaneli yezintandokazi zekhukhi.

section3.title: 3. Isisekelo Sezomthetho (GDPR)
body: Sicubungula idatha yomuntu siqu kulezi zisekelo ezingokomthetho ezilandelayo: imvume yakho (yamakhukhi angabalulekile nokumaketha), ukusebenza kwenkontileka (kumasevisi owacelayo), isibopho esingokomthetho, kanye nezintshisakalo ezisemthethweni lapho amalungelo akho engazikhiphi. Ungahoxisa imvume nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngaphandle kokuthikameze ukuba semthethweni kokucubungula okwenziwa ngaphambi kokuhoxa.

section4.title: 4. Amalungelo Akho
body: Kuya ngendawo okuyo, ungase ube nelungelo lokufinyelela, ukulungisa, ukusula, noma ukukhawulela ukucutshungulwa kwedatha yakho yomuntu siqu, ukuphikisa ukucutshungulwa, kanye nokuphatheka kwedatha. Ungakwazi futhi ukufaka isikhalazo kumphathi wendawo yangakini.

section5.title: 5. Ukugcinwa Kwedatha Nokuphepha
body: Sigcina idatha yomuntu siqu kuphela uma kudingeka ngezinjongo ezichazwe kule nqubomgomo. Sisebenzisa izinyathelo ezifanele zobuchwepheshe nezenhlangano ukuze sivikele ulwazi lwakho ekufinyeleleni okungagunyaziwe, ukuguqulwa, ukudalulwa noma ukonakaliswa.

section6.title: 6. Izinkonzo Zeqembu Lesithathu
body: Amanye amakhukhi angasethwa abahlinzeki bezinkampani zangaphandle (njengama-analytics noma izinkundla zokukhangisa) ezisisiza ukuthi sisebenzise iwebhusayithi. Laba bahlinzeki bacubungula idatha ngaphansi kwezinqubomgomo zabo zobumfihlo futhi kuphela uma uvumele isigaba esifanele.

information-reporting-systems.tagline: Ulwazi Olulungile. Ngesikhathi Esifanele. Ukuze uthole Izinqumo Ezingcono.
overview: Abaholi bamabhizinisi namathimba asebenzayo bancike olwazini olunembile ukuze benze izinqumo eziphusile. Ulwazi lwethu Nezinhlelo Zokubika zisiza izinhlangano ukuthi ziqoqe, zihlele, zihlaziye futhi zethule ulwazi lwebhizinisi ngamasistimu olwazi ahlelekile, izinkundla zokubika, amadeshibhodi, nokugeleza kokusebenza kokubika okuzenzakalelayo.

Izinhlangano zivame ukuba nolwazi olusatshalaliswa kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza, amaspredishithi, isizindalwazi, namasistimu okusebenza. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukusungula umbono ongaguquki wokusebenza kwebhizinisi. Sisiza ukuhlanganisa imithombo yolwazi ezindaweni zokubika ezihlelekile ezihlinzeka ngolwazi lwebhizinisi oluthembekile, olufinyelelekayo, nolungaguquguquki.
transformation: Uhlelo lokubika akufanele luvele luveze izinombolo. Kufanele isize abasebenzisi baqonde ukusebenza, babone izinkinga, bathole amathuba, futhi benze izinqumo ezinolwazi.
Siklama izindawo zokubika ngendlela inhlangano yakho esebenza ngayo, siletha amasistimu e-ecosystem ahlelekile edatha kuya ezinqumweni aklanyelwe zonke izigaba zokuphatha.

managed-services.title: Izinkonzo Eziphethwe
managed-services.tagline: Imisebenzi Yobuchwepheshe Ethembekile. Ukusekela Ochwepheshe. Ukuthuthukiswa Okuqhubekayo.
overview: Izimo zesimanje ze-IT ziyinkimbinkimbi futhi zihlala zishintsha. Izinhlangano zidinga ingqalasizinda ethembekile, izinhlelo zokusebenza, amanethiwekhi, ukuphepha, ukuqapha, nokusekelwa kobuchwepheshe ukuze kugcinwe ukusebenza kwebhizinisi.

Izinsizakalo Zethu Eziphethwe zihlinzeka ngokuphathwa kobuchwepheshe okuqhubekayo kanye nokwesekwa kokusebenza, okuvumela izinhlangano ukuthi zigcine izimo ze-IT ezithembekile kuyilapho amaqembu angaphakathi egxile ezinhlelweni zamasu.
transformation: Ukwesekwa kwe-IT yendabuko kuvame ukugxila ekuxazululeni izinkinga ngemva kokwenzeka. Amasevisi aphethwe athatha indlela esheshayo ngokuqhubeka nokuqapha ingqalasizinda, izinhlelo zokusebenza, amasistimu, nezimo zokusebenza.
Le ndlela isiza ukuhlonza izinkinga ezingase zibe khona kusenesikhathi, igcine ukusebenza, ithuthukise ukutholakala, futhi inciphise ukuphazamiseka kokusebenza okungagwemeka.

capabilities.title: Ukuphathwa Kwenethiwekhi

capabilities.title: Ukuphathwa Kwezicelo
capabilities.desc: Sekela izindawo zohlelo lokusebenza ezibucayi ngokuqapha, ukulungisa, ukuxazulula iziphazamisi, nokuthuthukiswa kokusebenza.

customDevelopment.description: Ukuthuthukiswa kokuphela kuze kube sekupheleni kwezixazululo ezintsha zedijithali ezivela ezidingweni zebhizinisi kanye nesakhiwo sezixazululo ngokuthuthukiswa, ukuhlanganiswa, ukuhlola, ukuthunyelwa, nokusekelwa okuqhubekayo.
customDevelopment.row1Title: Ukuthuthukiswa Kokusuka Ekupheleni ukusuka Ezimfunekweni kuye Esilinganisweni
customDevelopment.row1P1: Yonke imizamo emisha yedijithali iqala ngezidingo ezihlukile, ukuhamba komsebenzi, kanye nezinjongo zamasu ezingakwazi ukuhlangatshezwana nazo ngesofthiwe elingana-wonke. Sisebenza ngokukhethekile ekwakheni amasistimu esofthiwe angokwezifiso, asebenza kahle kakhulu kusukela ekuqaleni.
customDevelopment.row1P2: Kusukela ekutholweni kwezidingo zokuqala kanye nedizayini yezakhiwo zobuchwepheshe kuya ekuthuthukisweni kwe-sprint esheshayo, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-API ecosystem, amapayipi okuhlola aqinile, nokuthunyelwa kwamafu okuzenzakalelayo, amaqembu ethu aphezulu onjiniyela athatha ubunikazi obugcwele bomjikelezo wempilo womkhiqizo wakho.
customDevelopment.row2P1: Siklama izakhiwo zesofthiwe eziqinile eziklanyelwe ukumelana nemithwalo esindayo yokukhiqiza. Kusukela kuma-microservices ajwayelekile kanye nezingemuva ezishayelwa umcimbi ukuya ekusakazweni kwedatha ephezulu kanye nama-GraphQL/REST API, sakha izinkundla ezikala kalula.
customDevelopment.row2P2: Ngokusungula izisekelo zekhodi ezihlanzekile, ezimodulayo ezihambisana nokuhlola okuzenzakalelayo kanye nokuhambisana nokuphepha okuqhubekayo, siqinisekisa ukuthi isisekelo sesofthiwe yakho siyalondolozeka, siyahloleka, futhi silungele ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwesikhathi eside.
customDevelopment.row3P1: Imodeli yethu yokulethwa ishumeka iyunithi ezenzakalelayo, ukuhlanganiswa, nokuhlola ukwehla kuya ekupheleni eduze nokugeleza komsebenzi okufakwe esitsheni se-CI/CD (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP).
customDevelopment.row3P2: Ngamademo okugijima abonisa ngale, ukubonwa kwesikhathi sangempela, kanye nesivinini esiqhutshwa yingqopha-mlando, siqinisekisa isikhathi esisheshayo sokuya emakethe ngaphandle kokufaka engozini ukuphepha, ukuzinza, noma ulwazi lomsebenzisi.
customDevelopment.row4Title: Ukusebenza Okuthembekile kwe-24/7 kanye Nenguquko Yesikhathi Eside
customDevelopment.row4P1: Ukuba bukhoma kuyisiqalo nje. Sihlinzeka ngokuqapha okusebenzayo, ukunakekelwa okusekelwa yi-SLA, ukuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda yamafu, ukulungisa ukusebenza, nokukhishwa kwezici okuqhubekayo.
customDevelopment.row4P2: Ithimba lethu lonjiniyela lisebenza njengesandiso semvelo senhlangano yakho, liqinisekisa ukuthi akukho sikhathi sokuphumula esingekho kanye nokuphakama okuqhubekayo kwezobuchwepheshe emakethe yakho.
customDevelopment.pillarsSub: Gcwalisa amakhono esitaki esigcwele akhiwe ukuze asuse imibono yakho isuke kuqanda iye ekukhiqizeni.
customDevelopment.pillar1Desc: Ukuhlaziywa kwebhizinisi lokujula, ukucaciswa kokusebenza, kanye nemephu yohambo lomsebenzisi ukuze kuchazwe imingcele yesixazululo esiqondile.
customDevelopment.pillar2Desc: Izakhiwo zomdabu zamafu ezingaka, ukwenziwa kwesizindalwazi, ukwakheka kwama-microservices, nezisekelo zokuphepha ze-zero-trust.
customDevelopment.pillar3Desc: Iwebhu yesimanjemanje enesiteki esigcwele kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zeselula ezakhiwe ngekhodi ehlanzekile, ukuphepha kohlobo, namazinga e-UI asebenzayo.
customDevelopment.pillar4Desc: High-throughput REST/GraphQL APIs, ama-orchestrations e-webhook, amasango okukhokha, nokuvumelanisa okungenazihibe kwe-ERP/CRM yenkampani yangaphandle.

customDevelopment.ctaSub: Uzakwethu ne-Oklut Technologies ukuze bakhe amapulani, ubunjiniyela, futhi basebenzise inkundla yakho yedijithali yangokwezifiso kusukela ezidingweni zebhizinisi kuya eqinisweni lokukhiqiza.
customDevelopment.pillar5Desc: Ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo okuqinile, ukuhlolwa komthwalo/ukucindezeleka, amaskena okuba sengozini, nezindawo zokuhlola ukwehla.
customDevelopment.pillar6Desc: Amapayipi e-CI/CD azenzakalelayo, i-orchestration yesiqukathi (Docker/K8s), ingqalasizinda njengekhodi, nokukhishwa kwe-zero-downtime.
customDevelopment.pillar7Desc: 24/7 ukuqapha okusebenzayo, i-telemetry yezempilo, ukuhlolwa kokusebenza, ukuchibiyela ukuphepha, nokugcinwa kwe-SLA okuqhubekayo.
customDevelopment.pillar8Desc: Isivinini sesici esivamile, ukuhlanganiswa kokuhlaziywa kwedatha, ukuthuthukiswa kwe-AI, nokuthuthukiswa kwezakhiwo.

processAutomation.description: Ukuzenzakalela kokuphela kuya ekupheleni kokugeleza komsebenzi kwebhizinisi, okuhlanganisa i-robotic process automation (RPA), ukucubungula imibhalo ehlakaniphile, izinjini zemithetho yebhizinisi, nokuhlanganiswa kwesistimu.
processAutomation.row1P1: Qeda ukufakwa kwedatha okwenziwa ngesandla okuphindaphindwayo, ukubuyisana kwezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, kanye nomzila wemibhalo. Sisebenzisa amabhothi e-RPA ebhizinisi enza imisebenzi ehleliwe engu-24/7 ngezinga lephutha elinguziro.
processAutomation.row1P2: Ngokuxhuma i-interface yedeskithophu yefa, izingemuva ze-SAP/ERP, kanye nesizindalwazi samafu, ama-software bots akhulula iqembu lakho ukuthi ligxile ezinhlelweni zebhizinisi zamasu.
processAutomation.row2P1: Faka, uhlukanise, futhi ukhiphe idatha kuma-invoyisi, izinkontileka, umazisi, nezimangalo ngokuzenzakalelayo. Amapayipi ethu aqhutshwa yi-AI aqinisekisa izinkambu ngokumelene nesizindalwazi sangaphakathi futhi acuphe ukugeleza kokugunyazwa okuzenzakalelayo.
processAutomation.row2P2: Finyelela amazinga okucubungula aqondile angaphezu kwama-95% kuyilapho wehlisa kakhulu izikhathi zokushintsha ukusuka ezinsukwini ukuya kumasekhondi.

processAutomation.row3P2: Ulwazi lugeleza ngaphandle komthungo kuyo yonke iminyango ngaphandle kokungenelela komuntu, luqeda izisele zokusebenza kanye nokubambezeleka kokuxhumana.
processAutomation.row4Title: Izibalo Zenqubo Yesikhathi Sangempela kanye nemininingwane ye-Kaizen
processAutomation.row4P1: Landelela izikhathi zokwenza inqubo, amamephu okushisa e-bottleneck, imvamisa yamaphutha, ne-ROI yezezimali kumadeshibhodi aphezulu esikhathi sangempela.
processAutomation.row4P2: Ukuxilongwa okuqhubekayo komshini wokufunda kuthola amathuba amasha okuzenzakalela, okugcina ibhizinisi lakho lisebenza ngendlela esebenza kahle kakhulu.
processAutomation.pillarsSub: Izibhlokhi zokwakha ezifakazelwe zokusebenza kwebhizinisi elihlakaniphile.
processAutomation.pillar1Desc: Izinyathelo eziningi ze-human-in-the-loop kanye nokugeleza komsebenzi wedijithali okuhlelwe ngomzila ozenzakalelayo nokukhuphukayo.
processAutomation.pillar2Desc: Amabhothi esofthiwe asekelwe emthethweni afaka ukufakwa kwedatha, ukubuyisana, nemisebenzi ehlukahlukene.
processAutomation.pillar3Desc: Abenzeli be-Cognitive AI abahumusha umongo, abafingqa umbhalo ongahlelekile, futhi benze izinqumo ezizenzakalelayo.
processAutomation.pillar4Desc: Icubungula ukumba izimayini, ukutholwa kwe-bottleneck, kanye nokugeleza komsebenzi we-Kaizen okwehlisa ngokuqhubekayo izindleko zokusebenza.
processAutomation.ctaTitle: Usulungele Ukuzenzakalela Ukuhamba Kokusebenza Kwebhizinisi Lakho?
processAutomation.ctaSub: Xhumana nabaklami bethu bemishini ukuze uhlonze amathuba e-ROI ephezulu futhi usebenzise ukugeleza kokusebenza kwedijithali okuhlakaniphile.

centreOfExcellence.description: Inhlangano emaphakathi yabaklami bezakhiwo abakhulu nochwepheshe besizinda esizinikezele ekulinganiseni izinqubo zobunjiniyela, ukushayela ukusungula izinto ezintsha, kanye nokusheshisa ukuqaliswa kwedijithali.
centreOfExcellence.row1P1: Isikhungo Sethu Sobuhle sisungula amaphethini edizayini ajwayelekile, ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo okuqinile, nezinqubo zokubuyekeza ikhodi engenasici ezisheshisa isikhathi ukuya emakethe kuyilapho isikweletu sobuchwepheshe sifinyelela kuqanda.
centreOfExcellence.row1F1: Amapayipi okukhishwa okuzenzakalelayo kwe-CI/CD anezibalo zemethrikhi ye-DORA
centreOfExcellence.row1F2: Amabhodi okubuyekezwa kwezakhiwo aqinile kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsiza ezincane
centreOfExcellence.row1F3: Ukuxhuma kokuphepha okuqhubekayo kanye nokuchibiyela okuzenzakalelayo kokuba sengozini
centreOfExcellence.row2P1: Sizama ngamamodeli okufunda emishini esimanjemanje, ama-agent e-AI angokwezifiso, kanye ne-automation ehlakaniphile yokuhamba komsebenzi ukuze sakhe imikhiqizo yebhizinisi yesizukulwane esilandelayo.
centreOfExcellence.row2F1: Ukuhlanganiswa kolwazi lwe-Enterprise Generative AI ne-RAG
centreOfExcellence.row2F2: Ukugeleza komsebenzi kwe-ejenti ye-AI ezenzakalelayo yenqubo yebhizinisi ezishintshayo
centreOfExcellence.row2F3: Ukwenza ngokwezifiso imodeli yokufunda komshini nokulungisa kahle
centreOfExcellence.row3P1: Siklama futhi silawula izindawo eziqinile ezinamafu amaningi ezakhelwe phezu kwezinhlaka zokuphepha ze-zero-trust, siqinisekisa ukuthi idatha yakho ihlala ivikelekile ezinsongweni eziguqukayo ze-cyber.
centreOfExcellence.row3F1: I-AWS, i-Azure, ne-GCP yomculo wengqalasizinda yamafu amaningi
centreOfExcellence.row3F2: Ukufinyelela kwenethiwekhi ye-Zero-trust (ZTNA) kanye nezinqubomgomo ze-IAM ezisekelwe endimeni
centreOfExcellence.row3F3: Ukuskena okuzenzakalelayo kokuphepha kwesiqukathi nokuphathwa okuyimfihlo
centreOfExcellence.pillarsSub: Izincwadi zokudlala zokuthuthukisa ezihleliwe zinika amandla izinkundla ezibaluleke kakhulu.
centreOfExcellence.pillar1Desc: Ukwengamela okuphelele okuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izixazululo zebhizinisi zihambisana nokukala okuqinile, ukuphepha, kanye nezinqubo zokuthobela imithetho.
centreOfExcellence.pillar2Desc: Amasistimu okuklama okuphathelene, amakhithi okuqala e-API, nezifanekiso ze-microservice ezingemuva ezinciphisa isikhathi sokuqala sokuthuthukiswa ngo-40%.
centreOfExcellence.pillar3Desc: Amapayipi okubonwa kwesikhathi sangempela athuthukile aqapha ukubambezeleka kwesicelo, izithiyo zokuphuma, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwensiza yamafu.
centreOfExcellence.pillar4Desc: Izinhlangano zangaphakathi ezihleliwe nezitifiketi ezihlakulela amakhono obuchwepheshe ajulile kuwo wonke amafu, ama-DevOps, kanye ne-AI esetshenziswayo.
centreOfExcellence.ctaSub: Uzakwethu ne-Oklut Tech's Center of Excellence ukuze kwakhiwe izakhiwo zamafu eziqinile, ukugeleza komsebenzi ngokuzenzakalela, nokusheshisa ukulethwa komkhiqizo wedijithali.
centreOfExcellence.p1Desc: Sungula ukubusa kwezakhiwo zebhizinisi ngokubanzi, iziqondiso zenqubomgomo, kanye nezindinganiso zokuthobela.
centreOfExcellence.p2Desc: Chaza izakhiwo eziyisethenjwa zesimanje, izitaki zobuchwepheshe ezihloliwe, namaphethini wezinsizakalo ezincane.
centreOfExcellence.p3Desc: Sheshisa isivinini sokuthuthuka ngezici ezabiwe, izifanekiso, izinsiza zokuqalisa, nezinhlelo zokuklama.
centreOfExcellence.p4Desc: Ukuqeqeshwa okuhlelekile, ukwelulekwa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nokunika amandla amakhono ukuze kukhushulwe ikhono lobunjiniyela beqembu.
centreOfExcellence.p5Desc: I-R&D kuma-ejenti e-AI, amapayipi ezishintshayo, nezinhlaka zesizukulwane esilandelayo ukuze kugcinwe umkhawulo wemakethe.
centreOfExcellence.p6Desc: Amamethrikhi obunjiniyela aqhutshwa yidatha (i-DORA), ukulinganisa kwe-SLA, nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi okuqhubekayo.

solutionEngineering.description: Ukuthuthukiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, izinkundla, ukuhamba komsebenzi, nezixazululo zebhizinisi ukuze kubhekwane nezidingo zebhizinisi eziyingqayizivele kanye nokuletha ukusebenza okuhambisanayo.
solutionEngineering.row1Title: Izici Bespoke Ezakhelwe Ukugeleza Komsebenzi Wakho
solutionEngineering.row1P1: Isoftware ejwayelekile yebhizinisi ngokuvamile iyasilela ekuhlangabezaneni nezidingo zebhizinisi ezikhethekile. Ithimba lethu lonjiniyela bangokwezifiso lithuthukisa amamojula ohlelo lokusebenza, imithetho yebhizinisi yangokwezifiso, nezandiso ezikhethekile eziklanyelwe ukusebenza kwakho.
solutionEngineering.row1P2: Kusukela ekuthuthukisweni kwangokwezifiso kwe-CRM ne-ERP kuya kumaphothali okusebenza akhethekile, sakha izici eziqondana kalula namaphethini okuhamba komsebenzi ethimba lakho okuyiwonawona.
solutionEngineering.row2P1: Xhuma izinhlelo zesofthiwe ezihlukene zibe i-ecosystem yedijithali ehlangene. Senza ngokwezifiso ama-REST nama-GraphQL API, izibambi ze-webhook, kanye nolayini bemilayezo yebhizinisi ukuze siqinisekise ukuvumelanisa idatha yesikhathi sangempela kuzo zonke izinkundla zakho.
solutionEngineering.row2P2: Ukuthi kuhlanganisa amathuluzi e-SaaS enkampani yangaphandle noma ukunweba izinkundla zobunikazi ezikhona, ukuhlanganiswa kwethu kwezakhiwo kubeka phambili ubuqotho bedatha, okuphumayo, kanye nesikhathi sokuphumula esingekho.
solutionEngineering.row3P1: Phakamisa izixhumanisi zefa ngesimanjemanje, okuhlangenwe nakho komsebenzisi okusabelayo okwenzelwe isivinini nokucaca. Senza kabusha izindawo ezingaphambili ezinamaphethini edizayini enembile, ukuthobela ukufinyeleleka, namamodeli okusebenzelana alula.
solutionEngineering.row3P2: Ngokuhambisanayo, onjiniyela bethu bokusebenza balungiselela imibuzo yesizindalwazi, amasu okulondoloza inqolobane, nosayizi benqwaba yangaphambili ukuze balethe izikhathi zokuphendula ngokushesha kuwo wonke amadivayisi.
solutionEngineering.pillarsSub: Izindlela zokwenza ngokwezifiso zebanga lebhizinisi ezakhelwe ukukala kalula.
solutionEngineering.pillar1Desc: I-logic yohlelo lokusebenza eyenzelwe wena kanye nemishini yesimo esizenzakalelayo elungiselelwe ngokuqondile emithethweni yakho yokusebenza yangaphakathi.
solutionEngineering.pillar2Desc: Amabhuloho edatha avikelekile, aqinisekisiwe axhumanisa ama-backend obunikazi, amagumbi e-ERP, amasango okukhokha, namasevisi wamafu.
solutionEngineering.pillar3Desc: Ukuzijwayeza kwezakhiwo okujulile okushintsha isofthiwe yebhizinisi ngaphandle kokwephula izindlela zokuthuthukisa noma izivumelwano zosekelo zomthengisi.
solutionEngineering.pillar4Desc: Ukuhlolwa kwemibuzo okunolaka, ukuqedwa kokuvuza kwenkumbulo, kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwe-CDN onqenqemeni kokulayishwa kwekhasi lesibili elingaphansi.
solutionEngineering.ctaTitle: Ulungele Ukwenza Ngokwezifiso Inkundla Yakho Yebhizinisi?
solutionEngineering.ctaSub: Xhumana nabaklami bethu bezisombululo ukuze udizayine futhi ukhiphe amamojula angokwezifiso, ukugeleza komsebenzi, nokuhlanganiswa okuklanyelwe izidingo zebhizinisi lakho.

digitalTransformation.description: Ukwenziwa kwesimanjemanje okuphelele kwezinqubo zebhizinisi, ukwakheka kobuchwepheshe, namamodeli okusebenza ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokushesha kwenhlangano, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nokukhula kwedijithali okusimeme.
digitalTransformation.row1Title: Ukusuka kumbono kuya kumephu yomgwaqo osebenzisekayo
digitalTransformation.row1P1: Sisebenzisana nabaholi bamabhizinisi ukuze sichaze isu ledijithali, izimo zebhizinisi, kanye nemigwaqo ehlukaniswa ngezigaba ngokuwina okusheshayo kanye nokukhipha engozini.
digitalTransformation.row1P2: Izinyathelo ezibekwe phambili, amamodeli e-TCO, nama-KPIs aqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imizamo yokwenza ubuchwepheshe besimanje ixhumene ngqo nemali engenayo, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nemiphumela yokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende.
digitalTransformation.row2P1: Phinda wenze inkundla i-monoliths kuma-microservices, ama-API, kanye namaphethini omdabu wamafu anezinqamuli zesikhathi esiphansi nokuqinisekiswa kokuhlehla okuzenzakalelayo.
digitalTransformation.row2P2: Senza izinhlelo zokusebenza zibe zesimanjemanje, imininingwane egciniwe, kanye nezendlalelo zokuhlanganisa sibe silondoloza ukuthobelana nokuma kokuphepha.
digitalTransformation.row3P1: Yamukela i-AWS, i-Azure, ne-GCP, yakha amapayipi edatha yesimanje, futhi ushumeke ama-ejenti okufunda ngomshini ukuze aqondise izinqumo ezizimele.
digitalTransformation.row3P2: Ukusuka ekusakazeni umcimbi wesikhathi sangempela kuye kumadeshibhodi ahlanganisiwe, ukuguqulwa kuyalinganiseka futhi kuqhubeke.
digitalTransformation.row4P1: Hlela kabusha uhambo lwekhasimende kuyo yonke iwebhu ephendulayo, i-iOS, i-Android, kanye nezingosi zokuzisiza ezinokuxhumana komuntu siqu.
digitalTransformation.row4P2: Ubunjiniyela benkundla, i-telemetry, kanye nezihibe zempendulo ezizenzakalelayo kwenza ukuqamba okusha kwedijithali kuqhubeke.
digitalTransformation.pillarsSub: Amaleveli agxile kumphumela aqinisekisa ubuholi obuqhubekayo bedijithali.
digitalTransformation.pillar1Desc: Ipulani yenguquko enezigaba enemodeli yezebhizinisi, ukubusa kwezakhiwo, kanye nokulandelela ubungozi obuyingqophamlando.
digitalTransformation.pillar2Desc: Izisekelo ze-AWS/Azure/GCP ezinamafu amaningi, amapayipi azenzakalelayo, namandla okuhlaziya idatha yebhizinisi.
digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Inqubo ehlakaniphile yokuzenzakalela, ama-ejenti e-AI yokuqonda, kanye ne-telemetry ebikezelayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwansuku zonke.
digitalTransformation.pillar4Desc: Izingosi zedijithali zamashaneli onke aguqulela phezulu kanye nezindawo eziqondene nawe ezakhelwe ukugcinwa kwabasebenzisi okuphezulu.
digitalTransformation.ctaSub: Uzakwethu ne-Oklut Technologies ukuze kube nezinguquko zedijithali ezihlukaniswe ngezigaba, ezingenabungozi ezihambisana nemiphumela yebhizinisi elinganisekayo.

endToEndSolutions.description: Uhlaka oluhlelekile, olugcwele impilo yonke oluhlanganisa izidingo zebhizinisi, idizayini yezakhiwo, ubunjiniyela, ukuhlanganiswa, ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi, ukuthunyelwa kwamafu, kanye nemisebenzi ephethwe.
endToEndSolutions.row1P1: Izinkundla zokucobelelana ngolwazi, ukwenza imephu yesizinda sebhizinisi, kanye nemininingwane yezakhiwo zamafu eziklanyelwe ukuqeda ubungozi ngaphambi kokubhalwa komugqa wekhodi.
endToEndSolutions.row1P2: Sichaza amamodeli edatha, izinhlaka zokuphepha, kanye nezinyathelo ezibalulekile ezibeka impumelelo yesikhathi eside.
endToEndSolutions.row2P1: Ama-microservices ajwayelekile, ama-API aphephile, kanye nezingaphambili ezisabelayo kuhlanganiswe neyunithi ezenzakalelayo, ukuhlanganiswa, nezikena zokuphepha.
endToEndSolutions.row2P2: Amapayipi okuhlanganiswa okuqhubekayo ne-GitHub Actions, Terraform, nezinsimbi zonogada ezizenzakalelayo.
endToEndSolutions.row3P1: I-orchestration enamafu amaningi ku-AWS/Azure/GCP enokubuyiselwa emuva okuzenzakalelayo, ama-cutovers we-zero-downtime, nokubonakala kwesikhathi sangempela.
endToEndSolutions.row3P2: Sihlinzeka ngokulungiswa okusekelwe ku-SLA kanye nokuqapha okuqhubekayo kwe-telemetry ukuze siguqule umkhiqizo wakho ngaphandle komthungo.
endToEndSolutions.row4P1: Ukuziphendulela kwephuzu elilodwa kuso sonke isitaki sakho sedijithali — isivinini sokugijima esisobala, uhlahlomali olubikezelwayo, kanye nokuqamba okusha okuqhubekayo.
endToEndSolutions.row4P2: Ukukhishwa kwesici okuvamile nemijikelezo yesimanje kugcina ibhizinisi lakho lihamba phambili emncintiswaneni.
endToEndSolutions.pillar1Desc: Ukutholwa kwesizinda, imigwaqo yezakhiwo, nokuqondanisa ababambiqhaza ukuze kuqedwe ubungozi bokusebenzisa.
endToEndSolutions.pillar2Desc: Ama-microservices aqinile atholakala kumafu, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-API, nokuhlolwa kwe-QA okuqhubekayo.
endToEndSolutions.pillar3Desc: Ukuthobelana nokuphepha kwe-Zero-trust, ukukhishwa okufakwe esitsheni, nokuthunyelwa kwamafu okuzenzakalelayo.
endToEndSolutions.pillar4Desc: 24/7 Ukuqapha kwe-SLA, i-telemetry yezempilo, nobunjiniyela obuqhubekayo bokuziphendukela kwemvelo.
endToEndSolutions.ctaSub: Singabanikazi bomjikelezo wempilo ophelele wobuchwepheshe ukuze iqembu lakho ligxile emiphumeleni ewumongo yebhizinisi.

migrationServices.description: Ukufuduka okuvikelekile, okuhlelekile kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zefa, imininingo egciniwe, nengqalasizinda kuya ezakhiweni zamafu zesimanje, ezimataniswe nokuthuthukiswa kwesimanje okuqhubekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle nokusebenza kahle.
migrationServices.row1P1: Ukuthuthela komsebenzi okungenazihibe ku-AWS, i-Azure, ne-Google Cloud ngokutholakala okuzenzakalelayo, ukuhlela kwamagagasi, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwebhizinisi okuyiziro.
migrationServices.row1P2: Sibhalansisa ukusingathwa kabusha, ukulungisa kabusha, nokwenza kabusha ukuze sithuthukise izindleko eziphelele zobunikazi (TCO) nekhono.
migrationServices.row2Title: Vikela i-ETL kanye Nokuqinisekiswa Kwedatha Okuzenzakalelayo
migrationServices.row2P1: Ukuphindaphinda kwesizindalwazi okuzenzakalelayo, ukuhumusha kwe-schema, namapayipi e-ETL adlula wonke anokuqinisekiswa kobuqotho bedatha okungu-100%.
migrationServices.row2P2: Ukuzijwayeza kwe-Zero-downtime cutover kuqinisekisa ukuvumelana okuphelele kwedatha nokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi.
migrationServices.row3P1: Yenza kube simanjemanje ama-monolith ayigugu abe yizinsiza ezincane ezingakalayo ezihlelwe nge-Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) ngamapulani e-IaC azenzakalelayo.
migrationServices.row3P2: Iphrofayela yokusebenza kwangemva kokufuduka kanye nokuthuthukisa izindleko kuqinisekisa i-ROI esheshayo.
migrationServices.row4P1: Ama-cutover runbooks ahlolelwe impi, ama-automated regression suite, nezindlela zokuhlehlisa ngokushesha zokuthula kwengqondo okuphelele.
migrationServices.row4P2: I-telemetry yezempilo yangemva kokufuduka kanye ne-24/7 hypercare iqinisekisa ukuzinza kokukhiqiza okungenasici.
migrationServices.pillarsSub: Izinyathelo zokususwa ebungozini zisekelwa ama-SLA ebhizinisi.
migrationServices.pillar1Desc: Ukukhishwa kwe-Canary kanye nesizindalwazi sokuvumelanisa kokubhala kabili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela komsebenzisi okungaphazamiseki.
migrationServices.pillar2Desc: Ukuqhathaniswa kwe-Checksum, ukuhlolwa kobuqotho be-schema, nokubuyisana kwe-ETL okuzenzakalelayo.
migrationServices.pillar3Desc: Imithetho eqinile yokutakula izinhlekelele kanye nokuprakthiza ukuze kunqandwe ubungozi kuzo zonke izigaba.
migrationServices.pillar4Desc: Ukunika amalungelo amafu, izinqubomgomo zokukala ngokuzenzakalelayo, namadeshibhodi okuphatha izindleko afakiwe.
migrationServices.ctaSub: Uzakwethu ne-Oklut Technologies ekwenzeni ifu elihlelekile, elingenabungozi kanye nokwenza idatha ibe yisimanje.

pilotPrototyping.description: Ukuthuthukiswa okusheshayo nokuqinisekiswa kwezixazululo zobuchwepheshe ukuze kuhlolwe ukusebenza kobuchwepheshe, inani lebhizinisi, izidingo zokuhlanganisa, ukusebenza, kanye nokulinganisa ngaphambi kokuqaliswa okuphelele.
pilotPrototyping.row1P1: Ukuguqula umbono ube yisixazululo esilinganisweni sebhizinisi kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kwangaphambili okuqinile. Isevisi yethu ye-PoC & Pilot ihlola ukusebenza kobuchwepheshe, ihlola ingcindezi-ihlola amahhuku okuhlanganisa abalulekile, futhi iqinisekisa i-ROI yebhizinisi ngaphambi kwezibopho ezinkulu zemali.
pilotPrototyping.row1P2: Sakha ama-MVP athembekile kakhulu kanye nabashayeli bezindiza be-sandbox abagxilile abafakazela ukuba nokwenzeka kobuchwepheshe, balinganise ukubambezeleka kwesistimu, futhi baqoqe ukuqinisekiswa okuqondile kwababambe iqhaza kusenesikhathi.
pilotPrototyping.row1Cap: I-MVP Prototyping Esheshayo kanye Nezilinganiso Zobuchwepheshe
pilotPrototyping.row2P1: Sakha ama-wireframes asebenzisanayo, ukugeleza komsebenzisi okuchofozekayo, kanye nemibono esebenzayo yobufakazi bezinsuku, hhayi izinyanga. Hlola ukusebenzisana kwangempela komsebenzisi, yenza ngcono amaphethini e-UI/UX, futhi uqoqe impendulo engenzeka evela kubabambiqhaza.
pilotPrototyping.row2P2: Ngokufushanisa ama-loops empendulo phakathi nokuthuthukiswa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi, ithimba lakho linciphisa ukusebenza kabusha futhi lithole imininingwane ecacile yobuchwepheshe ngaphambi kokuba kuqale izigaba zokwakha ezidinga imali eningi.
pilotPrototyping.row3P1: Thola izingqinamba zobuchwepheshe, imikhawulo ye-API, nezingqinamba zokusebenza ngaphambi kokuzibophezela okugcwele kwekhephithali. Ithimba lethu lonjiniyela lokuhlola lihlola ukucindezelwa kokuhlolwa kokuhlanganiswa, amaphayiphi edatha, nama-API ezinkampani zangaphandle ezindaweni ezingazodwa ze-sandbox.
pilotPrototyping.row3P2: Lokhu kunciphisa ubungozi okusebenzayo kuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwesistimu ephezulu, ukuthobela ukuphepha, kanye nezikhathi zentuthuko ezibikezelwayo lapho uguqulela i-PoC yakho ekukhiqizeni ibhizinisi.
pilotPrototyping.row4Title: Ukwethulwa Komshayeli Okuhlosiwe Nokuqinisekiswa Kwecala Lebhizinisi
pilotPrototyping.row4P1: Khipha ukukhishwa kokuhlola okuhlosiwe kusigaba esikhethiwe somsebenzisi noma imakethe yokuhlola. Landelela amamethrikhi okusebenza, izibalo zokutholwa komsebenzisi, nempendulo yokusebenza ukuze ulinganise inani lebhizinisi futhi usungule icala lebhizinisi elisekelwe idatha.
pilotPrototyping.row4P2: Ngemininingwane yokuhlola yomhlaba wangempela, abaxhasi abakhulu bathola amamethrikhi e-ROI acacile ukuze bathethelele ukusetshenziswa okubanzi kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali koshintsho lwedijithali.
pilotPrototyping.pillarsSub: Izimiso eziqondisayo eziguqula ukungaqiniseki kobuchwepheshe kube impumelelo yebhizinisi ebikezelwayo.
pilotPrototyping.pillar1Desc: Letha ama-prototypes asebenzayo ngokushesha ukuze uqinisekise iziphakamiso zenani ngaphambi kwesikhathi somjikelezo wempilo.
pilotPrototyping.pillar2Desc: Qinisekisa ukuhambisana kwe-API, imikhawulo yokuphuma, kanye nemingcele yokuthobelana nezindawo ze-sandbox.
pilotPrototyping.pillar3Desc: Lingisa umthwalo wokukhiqiza ukuze umise imikhawulo yamandla futhi unqume ubukhulu bezakhiwo zamafu.
pilotPrototyping.pillar4Desc: Linganisa i-ROI ephathekayo kanye namamethrikhi okukhiqiza ukuze kusekelwe izinqumo zokukhishwa kwebhizinisi lonke.
pilotPrototyping.ctaTitle: Ukulungele ukuqinisekisa isixazululo sakho esilandelayo sedijithali?
pilotPrototyping.ctaSub: Xhumana nethimba lethu lonjiniyela besixazululo ukuze uhlole izidingo zephrojekthi yakho, wakhe isibonelo, futhi uhlole ukuthi kungenzeka yini ngaphandle kobungozi.

sharedServices.description: Ukulethwa kwethekhnoloji kanye namandla okusebenza endaweni eyodwa kuzo zonke izinhlaka zebhizinisi ngezinqubo ezisezingeni, izinsiza ezinamakhono, izinhlaka zokubusa, ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo, namazinga esevisi alinganisekayo.
sharedServices.row1Title: Izinsizakalo Ezijwayelekile Kuwo Wonke Amayunithi Ebhizinisi

aiRobotics.intro: I-Artificial Intelligence (AI) kanye namaRobhothi aguqula indlela amabhizinisi asebenza ngayo ngokuhlanganisa ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile nokuzenzakalelayo okuthuthukile. I-AI inika amandla imishini ukuthi ihlaziye idatha, ifunde amaphethini, futhi yenze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, kuyilapho amarobhothi eletha lawa makhono emhlabeni ophathekayo ukuze enze imisebenzi ngesivinini, ngokunemba, nangokungaguquguquki.
aiRobotics.section1Text: Izixazululo zethu ze-AI namarobhothi zisiza izinhlangano ukuthi zilawule ukusebenza, zinciphise umzamo owenziwa ngezandla, futhi zithuthukise ukukhiqiza kuzo zonke izimboni ezihlukahlukene. Kusukela kuzinqubo ezizenzakalelayo nokuhlaziya okubikezelayo kuye kumarobhothi ahlakaniphile namasistimu ahlakaniphile, siletha ubuchwepheshe obusha obuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, obuqhubezela phambili ukukhula, futhi obusekela ukuguqulwa kwedijithali.
aiRobotics.section2Text: Konke ukusebenzelana, izinqumo, nokunyakaza kunikwa amandla isistimu eyodwa exhunyiwe — ukuguqula idatha ibe yimiphumela ngesikhathi sangempela.

informationReporting.heroSubtitle: Umthombo owodwa weqiniso wawo wonke umnyango - eyakhelwe ukuguqula idatha yokusebenza engahluziwe ibe izinqumo ibhizinisi lakho elingakwazi ukuzithatha namuhla.
informationReporting.section1Heading: Isistimu eyodwa emaphakathi yayo yonke imethrikhi ebalulekile
informationReporting.section1P1: Ulwazi Nezinhlelo Zokubika ziyizixazululo zebhizinisi ezibalulekile ezenza izinhlangano zikwazi ukuqoqa, ukuphatha, futhi ziguqule idatha ibe imininingwane ephusile. Lezi zinhlelo zihlanganisa imininingwane evela eminyangweni eminingi, iqinisekisa ukufinyelela okunembile, okungaguquki, nesikhathi sangempela kudatha yebhizinisi ebalulekile. Ngokuhlinzeka ngenkundla emaphakathi yokuphathwa kolwazi, izinhlangano zingathuthukisa ukubonakala kokusebenza, ziqondise ukuhamba komsebenzi, futhi zisekele ukuthathwa kwezinqumo kwamasu kuwo wonke amazinga ebhizinisi.
informationReporting.section1P2: Lawa masistimu asebenzisa ukubika okuzenzakalelayo, izibalo, namadeshibhodi ukuze alandelele ukusebenza, aqaphe amamethrikhi angukhiye, futhi enze imibiko yesikhathi sangempela. Ngokunciphisa umzamo owenziwe ngesandla nokuthuthukisa ukunemba kwedatha, amabhizinisi angenza izinqumo ezisheshayo nezisebenza ngempumelelo.
informationReporting.section2Text: Ngokubonakala okuthuthukisiwe, ukuthobelana, nokusebenzisana, Amasistimu Wolwazi Nokubika anika amandla izinhlangano ukuthi zithuthukise izinqubo, zithuthukise ukukhiqiza, futhi ziqhubekisele phambili ukukhula kwebhizinisi okusimeme endaweni enokuncintisana.
informationReporting.ctaHeading: Nikeza lonke iqembu isithombe sesikhathi sangempela sebhizinisi.

artificialIntelligence.sec5Subtext: Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibonisiwe eziletha izinzuzo ezisebenza kahle ezilinganisekayo kuzo zonke izizinda zebhizinisi zokusebenza.
artificialIntelligence.sec6Subtext: Izinzuzo ezibambekayo zokukhiqiza namandla okusebenza atholakala ngokutholwa kwe-AI yebhizinisi.
artificialIntelligence.ctaHeading: Ukulungele Ukuhlanganisa I-AI Yomdabu Kuzicelo Zakho Zebhizinisi?
artificialIntelligence.ctaDescription: Xhuma nokuzijwayeza kwe-Oklut Technologies AI ukuze uklame, uhlole, futhi ukhiphe amakhophi ebhizinisi e-AI nezinjini ezizenzakalelayo ezihlakaniphile.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P1: Iminyaka eminingi, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa bebhizinisi bebuthathwa njengamandla angaphandle: imodeli eqeqeshelwe ukuhlala yodwa, umboniso we-sandbox, noma i-chatbot engayodwa efinyeleleka ngephothali ehlukile. Namuhla, i-paradigm isishintshile ngokuyisisekelo. I-AI yebhizinisi elinomthelela omkhulu ishumekwe ngqo ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zerekhodi—ama-ERP, ama-CRM, amapulatifomu okuphatha abantu, kanye nezinjini zokuhlinzeka lapho ibhizinisi langempela lenzeka khona.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P2: Uma ubuhlakani busebenza ngaphakathi kwesistimu yerekhodi, buzuza njengefa imingcele yokuvikela emisiwe yenhlangano, amamodeli edatha, nokucabanga kwebhizinisi. Ayimane nje ikhiqize izimpendulo ezijwayelekile; isebenza ngama-oda abukhoma, ihumusha amathikithi osekelo avulekile, ihlanganisa ama-invoyisi abahlinzeki, futhi isiza abasebenzi phakathi kwezindawo eziqondile abazizulazula nsuku zonke.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P3: Lolu shintsho lususa isofthiwe yebhizinisi kusuka kusizindalwazi esilindile esilinda ukuchofoza okhiye babantu kuya ezinkundleni ezisebenzayo ezilindele izidingo, izinyathelo ezizenzakalelayo, kanye nezincomo ezifika ngesikhathi.
artificialIntelligence.sec2P1: I-Traditional Robotic Process Automation (RPA) iphumelele ekunqumeni, ukuklwebha kwesikrini okuphindaphindayo. Nokho, izimiso eziqinile zokusetha ziyahlukana noma nini lapho ifomu lishintsha, ukwakheka kwedokhumenti okungalindelekile kufika, noma kwenzeka okuhlukile. I-automation ehlakaniphile ivala lokhu kuhlukana ngokuhlanganisa ukucabanga kwengqondo nokwenza umsebenzi:

sec2List.text: Ukuhlela imisebenzi eyinkimbinkimbi yeminyango ehlukahlukene, imisebenzi yomzila esuselwe ekuphuthumeni nasekuxazululeni izindlela zomlando.
Ukungenisa ama-PDF angahlelekile, ama-imeyili, ama-manifest wokuthumela, nezinkontileka, kuguqulelwe kumisebenzi yedatha ehleliwe.
Ukwenza ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuqinisekiswa kokusebenza kwezinyathelo eziningi—njengokufanisa ama-oda okuthenga ngokuqhathaniswa namarisidi nezitatimende zasebhange.
Ukuhlaziya amalogi enqubo ngokuqhubekayo ukuze kutholakale izingqinamba zesikhathi somjikelezo futhi kunconywe ukuthuthukiswa okuqondisiwe kokugeleza komsebenzi.

copilotCards.title: Ukucinga Ulwazi
copilotCards.desc: Ukubuyiselwa kwe-Semantic kuzo zonke izisekelo zolwazi ezisabalalisiwe, izinqubomgomo ze-intranethi, ukucaciswa komkhiqizo, nezinqumo zomlando zamathikithi ngaphandle kokuqagela igama elingukhiye.

copilotCards.title: Ukufingqwa Kwedokhumenti
copilotCards.desc: Ukucwiliswa ngokushesha kwama-RFP amade, izivumelwano zabathengisi, imininingwane yobuchwepheshe, kanye nezichibiyelo zomthetho zibe izifinyezo zezikhulu ezingasetshenzwa kanye nezinhlu zokuhlola ubungozi.

copilotCards.title: Isizukulwane Sokuqukethwe
copilotCards.desc: Ukwakhiwa okusizwayo kweziphakamiso zamakhasimende, imibhalo yokusebenza, izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza (ama-SOP), nezibuyekezo ezijwayelekile zamakhasimende ezihambisana namazinga omkhiqizo.

copilotCards.title: Ukuhlaziywa Kwedatha
copilotCards.desc: Ukuhumusha imibuzo yengxoxo ibe imibuzo ehlaziyayo eyinkimbinkimbi, okukhiqiza izifinyezo zeshadi endizeni futhi kugqanyiswe izici ezibalulekile zobuholi.

copilotCards.title: Ukuhamba Kwebhizinisi
copilotCards.desc: Ukuqalisa okwenziwayo ngokuqondile kusuka ekwazisweni kwengxoxo—njengokuhlela izinsiza, ukudala amathikithi, ukubuyekeza amarekhodi, noma ukuthumela izicelo zokuthenga.

copilotCards.title: Ukufinyelela Okusekelwe Indima
copilotCards.desc: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimpendulo zomshayeli zihlonipha ngokuqinile amazinga emvume yomsebenzisi, ukugcinwa kwezimali kuyimfihlo, amafayela akwa-HR, kanye nempahla yengqondo evikelekile.

artificialIntelligence.sec4P1: Nakuba amamodeli okukhiqiza enza kahle kakhulu ekuqondeni nasekuhlanganiseni ulimi, ubuhlakani bokubikezela bugxile emaphethini ezibalo afihlwe ngaphakathi kwamasethi edatha ebhizinisi ahlelekile. Amamodeli aqagelayo ashumekiwe anika amandla izinhlangano ukuthi zilindele izithiyo zokusebenza ngaphambi kokuthi ziphazamise ukusebenza:

sec4List.text: Ukubikezela amathrendi emali engenayo, isivinini sempahla, nezimfuno zezinsiza ngokuhlanganisa izinkomba zesizini ngesivinini sepayipi lesikhathi sangempela.
Ukukhomba ubungozi bokuguquguquka kwamakhasimende, imijikelezo yokuwohloka kwesondlo, nokubambezeleka kochungechunge lokuhlinzeka ngesikhathi sisekhona isikhathi sokungenelela.
Ukuhlaba umkhosi okudidayo emisebenzini yezezimali, amalogi okuthobela imithetho, namaphethini okuthenga komthengisi ngaphambi kokuthi kunyuke.
Ukuvumelanisa izibikezelo zokuthengisa namandla okukhiqiza kanye namazinga amasheya esitolo ukuze kuvikelwe imali yokusebenza.

artificialIntelligence.keyPerspectiveLead: I-AI ithembeke kuphela njengesisekelo sedatha ngaphansi kwayo kanye nokubusa okuzungezile. Ukwamukelwa kwebhizinisi esimeme kudinga isiyalo sokwakha ngamabomu:

modernErp.title: Ukusheshisa Ukuguqulwa Kwebhizinisi nge-ERP yesimanje
modernErp.subtitle: Hlola ukuthi izinkundla zesimanje ze-ERP zixhuma kanjani ezezimali, ukuthengwa kwempahla, uchungechunge lokuhlinzeka nemisebenzi yebhizinisi ngesisekelo esihlanganisiwe sedijithali.
modernErp.imageCaption: I-Enterprise Technology Perspective — I-ERP Exhunyiwe & Nekhono Lokusebenza

connectedFunctions.title: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali
connectedFunctions.desc: Izibuyekezo zamaleja esikhathi sangempela, ukubonwa kwemali engenayo okuzenzakalelayo, nokuvumelanisa okusheshayo kwezinhlobo eziningi zemali.

connectedFunctions.title: I-Supply Chain & Logistics
connectedFunctions.desc: Ukubonakala kwempahla ekupheleni kuya ekupheleni, ukuthuthukiswa kwe-warehouse, kanye ne-telemetry yokusebenza komhlinzeki.

connectedFunctions.title: Abasebenzi Nezisebenzi
connectedFunctions.desc: Izingosi zezisebenzi ezizisizayo, ukukhokhelwa okuzenzakalelayo, kanye nokuhlelwa okudidiyelwe komjikelezo wempilo.

connectedFunctions.title: Ukuthengwa Kwempahla Nokuthola usizo
connectedFunctions.desc: Izimvume zokuthenga ezizenzakalelayo, ukuthobela inkontileka yomthengisi, nezibalo zezindleko eziguquguqukayo.

modernCapabilities.title: I-Cloud-Native Architecture
modernCapabilities.desc: Isilinganiso sekhompyutha esinwebekayo ngaphandle kwekhanda lengqalasizinda ephezu kwendlu noma ukukhiya kwenguqulo ephazamisayo.

modernCapabilities.title: Vula i-API Ecosystem
modernCapabilities.desc: Izixhumi ezakhelwe ngaphambilini ezivumela ukuvumelanisa kwedatha yezindlela ezimbili ezingenazihibe ngamasevisi amancane angokwezifiso namasuite e-CRM.

modernCapabilities.title: Izibalo Ezishumekiwe
modernCapabilities.desc: Ukudonsela phansi okuqondile kudeshibhodi kusuka kumashidi ebhalansi ezinga eliphezulu kuya kumalogi omsebenzi ngamunye.

modernCapabilities.title: Izibangeli zokuhamba komsebenzi ezizenzakalelayo
modernCapabilities.desc: Umcimbi oshayelwa umcimbi ucupha ukwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yeminyango ehlukahlukene ngokuzenzakalelayo.

erpBusinessBenefits: Umthombo owodwa weqiniso osusa imibiko eshayisanayo yomnyango
Ukwehliswa okukhulu kwemijikelezo yokuphela kwenyanga neyokuphela kwekota
I-inventory yesikhathi sangempela kanye nokubonakala kwempahla kunciphisa ukuphela kwesitoko
Kwehliswe ukunakekelwa kwe-IT phezulu ngezibuyekezo ze-modular cloud-native
Ukulandelela ukuthobela imithetho okuhlanganisiwe kuzo zonke izindawo zentela zezifunda eziningi
Ukungena ngokushesha kwezinhlangano ezitholiwe kumgogodla wokusebenza okwabelwana ngawo
erpStrategyPoints: Ukuqondanisa izakhiwo ze-ERP nokugeleza komsebenzi okubalulekile ngaphambi kokucushwa
Ukukhetha amamodeli wokuphakelwa kwe-modular ukuze uthole impumelelo esheshayo
Ukubeka phambili ukuthuthwa kwedatha okuyinhloko nokubuyisana kwekhwalithi ephezulu
Ukushumeka ukuphathwa koshintsho oluzenzakalelayo nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihambisana neqhaza
Idizayina amasango e-API ukuze kunwetshwe ukuhlanganisa okuzayo okungagugi
modernErp.sec1Subtext: Ukusebenza kahle kwebhizinisi kuncike ekuvumelaniseni idatha ngaphandle komthungo kuyo yonke imali, ukuthengwa kwempahla, ukusebenza, kanye nabasebenzi.
modernErp.sec2Subtext: Ukudiliza izisele zeminyango ukuze kuvunyelwe idatha yokwenziwayo ukuthi igeleze ngokushesha kuzo zonke izingxenye zebhizinisi.
modernErp.sec3Subtext: I-digital spine exhunyiwe eqinisekisa ukuthi izinkontileka zokuthengisa zibuyekeza ngokushesha ama-oda e-supply chain namaleja ezezimali.
modernErp.sec4Subtext: Ubuhlakani bokusebenza obubukhoma buthatha indawo yamaspredishithi okubheka emuva abambezelekile ngezinkomba zokusebenza ezisheshayo.
modernErp.sec5Subtext: Izisekelo zezakhiwo ezihlukanisa izinkundla zamafu ezigugile kumasistimu e-monolithic yefa.
modernErp.sec6Subtext: Isivinini esibambekayo senhlangano, ukubeka izinto obala, kanye nokusebenza ngempumelelo kwezindleko kuvulwe izinkundla zesimanje ze-ERP.
modernErp.ctaHeading: Ukulungele Ukwenza Ibhizinisi Lakho Le-ERP Spine libe Lesimanjemanje?
modernErp.ctaDescription: Zitholele ukuthi i-Oklut Technologies ingakusiza kanjani ukuthi uhlanganise, ulungiselele, futhi uhlanganise izinkundla ze-ERP ezimodulayo eziklanyelwe ukusebenza kwebhizinisi lakho.
modernErp.sec1P1: Ezindaweni zamabhizinisi ezihamba ngokushesha, izinhlelo ze-Enterprise Resource Planning zivame ukuba nzima. Akhelwe enkathini yokucutshungulwa kwenqwaba kanye namaseva endawo ahlukanisiwe, ama-ERP efa enziwe ngokwezifiso kakhulu, kunzima ukuwathuthukisa, futhi afiphele kabuhlungu. Imisebenzi yebhizinisi ebalulekile ibisebenza kuma-siloes ahambisanayo, incike ekuthengisweni okuntekenteke ngobusuku obubodwa ukuze kuhlanganiswe amaleja nezindawo zokugcina impahla.
modernErp.sec1P2: I-ERP yesimanjemanje, yamafu ichaza kabusha lokhu kuguquguquka. Isebenza njengomgogodla wedijithali ohlanganisiwe webhizinisi—isisekelo esiphilayo lapho ezezimali, ukuthengwa kwempahla, uchungechunge lokuhlinzeka, i-inventory, kanye nezinsizakusebenza zabantu zihwebelana ngemodeli yedatha eyabiwe.
modernErp.sec1P3: Ngokuletha ukusebenza okubalulekile endaweni eyodwa evunyelanisiwe, i-ERP yesimanje iqeda izindawo eziyimpumputhe zokusebenza ezibambezela ukukhula, okuvumela abaholi ukuthi baqondise ibhizinisi besebenzisa amasignali esikhathi sangempela kunokuba izifinyezo zomlando zakudala.
modernErp.sec3P1: Izisele zokusebenza azivamile ukuba nezinkinga zabantu; ziyizinkinga zezakhiwo. Uma isevisi yamakhasimende, ukuthengwa kwempahla, kanye namathimba e-warehouse esebenza ezinhlelweni ezinqanyuliwe, konke ukunikezwa kudinga ama-imeyili okwenziwa mathupha, amaspredishithi, namakholi wefoni. Amaphutha ayanda, ama-invoyisi ayabanjwa, futhi izibopho zekhasimende ziyashibilika.
modernErp.sec3P2: I-ERP yesimanje ibhekana nalokhu ngohlu lwedatha oluhlanganisiwe kanye ne-orchestration yenqubo eqhutshwa umcimbi:

sec3List.text: Uma i-oda lekhasimende lifakwa, i-inventory igcina ngokuzenzakalelayo, amalebula okuthunyelwa kwemikhumbi akhiqiza, namaleja enkokhelo abuyekezwa ngaso leso sikhathi.

sec3List.bold: Ukubonisa izinto obala kokuthenga ukuze ukhokhe:
sec3List.text: Ama-oda okuthenga, amarisidi wezimpahla, nama-invoyisi omthengisi afana ngokuzenzakalelayo nokubuyisana kwezindlela ezi-3, kuhlaba umkhosi kuphela okuhlukile ukuze kubuyekezwe umuntu.
Amaphepha esikhathi ephrojekthi, ukwabiwa kweholo, kanye nemephu yezindleko zokusebenza eqondile ngqo ezikhungweni zezindleko ngesikhathi sangempela.

modernErp.sec4P1: Ukuqhuba ibhizinisi ngaphandle kokubonakala okuhlangene kufana nokundiza enkungu eminyene ngezisetshenziswa ezibambezelekile. I-ERP yesimanje inikeza i-telemetry yesikhathi sangempela kuwo wonke umkhakha webhizinisi:

sec4List.text: Ukubuka ngaleso sikhathi kwesamba semali, ukuhamba kwemali okusebenzayo, izikweletu ezivulekile, noku-oda okusalela emuva ngaphandle kokulinda ukuvalwa kokuphela kwesikhathi.
Izinhloko zeminyango zingakha imibuzo yangokwezifiso futhi zisuse izifinyezo zezinga lebhizinisi ziye ezintweni zomugqa wokwenziwayo ngamunye.
Ukuqeda izinombolo eziphikisanayo ngokusungula idatha eyinhloko ebuswayo eyodwa yamakhasimende, abathengisi, namakhathalogi emikhiqizo.
Izaziso ezizenzakalelayo zazisa abaphathi ngokushesha lapho amamajini ehla ngaphansi komkhawulo, uhlu lwempahla lwehla, noma isiliphu sokulethwa kwabahlinzeki.

cyberBusinessBenefits: Ukwehliswa okukhulu kokuhlaselwa kobungozi ezindaweni zonkana zezimpahla zamafu
Ukuqhubeka kokusebenza okuqinisekisiwe kanye nokutholwa kwenhlekelele nge-RTO/RPO encane
Ukwethembeka okuphelele kokuthobela kulo lonke ucwaningo lwe-ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, kanye ne-GDPR
Ukuvikelwa kwempahla yengqondo ewumgogodla yebhizinisi kanye namarekhodi ayimfihlo ekhasimende
Ukulawula ubungozi komthengisi kanye nenkampani yangaphandle ngezilawuli zokufinyelela ezihlangene
Ikhasimende elithuthukisiwe kanye nokwethenjwa komtshalizimali okusekelwe izimo zokuphepha eziqinisekisiwe ze-zero-trust
zeroTrustPrinciples: Ungalokothi Uthembe, Njalo Qinisekisa: Ukuqinisekisa okusobala kuyadingeka kukho konke okwenziwayo
Ukufinyelela Okuyilungelo Elincane: Imingcele yendima eyimbudumbudu ekhawulela ukunyakaza okusongelayo
Cabanga Ngokwephulwa: Ukuqapha okuqhubekayo kokusongela, ukubethela kwezokuthutha nalapho uphumule
I-Micro-Segmentation: I-firewall yenethiwekhi ehlukanisa imithwalo yemisebenzi yohlelo ngalunye
I-Telemetry Eqhubekayo: Ukuhlaziywa kokuziphatha okuzenzakalelayo okuhlaba umkhosi izicelo zeseshini ezixakile
cybersecurity.sec1Subtext: Njengoba amabhizinisi amukela izinsiza zamafu, amathimba asabalalisiwe akude, kanye namadivayisi e-IoT, imingcele yokuvikela evamile iyahlakazeka.
cybersecurity.sec2Subtext: Ukuxhumanisa ubuhlakani obusongelayo, ukuskena kokuba sengozini, kanye nempendulo yesigameko esizenzakalelayo kuso sonke isitaki sobuchwepheshe.
cybersecurity.sec3Subtext: I-Identity iyindiza yokulawula eyinhloko. Ukufinyelela kwe-Granular, i-MFA, ne-SSO kuqinisekisa ukuthi othishanhloko abagunyaziwe kuphela abafinyelela kumasistimu ebhizinisi.
cybersecurity.sec4Subtext: Umcabango oyisisekelo wokuvikeleka obikezelwe ekuqinisekiseni okuqhubekayo, ukugunyazwa okusobala, kanye nokucabangela ukuyekethisa.
cybersecurity.sec5Subtext: Ikhuluma ngamamodeli esibopho okwabelwana ngawo, Ingqalasizinda njenge-Code guardrails, kanye nokuvikelwa kwesikhathi sokusebenza kwe-Kubernetes.
cybersecurity.sec6Subtext: Ukulungiselela ama-runbook ahlelekile, izinsimbi zokuqukatha ezizenzakalelayo, nezipele ezingaguquki zokutakula izinhlekelele ukuze kuqine ukusebenza okuphelele.
cybersecurity.sec7Subtext: Ukuqina kwebhizinisi, ukuqinisekiswa kokuthobela, nokuvikela isithunzi somkhiqizo okulethwa ukuvikela ku-inthanethi kwesimanje.
cybersecurity.ctaHeading: Usulungele Ukuqinisa Ibhizinisi Lakho Ukusimama Kwe-Cyber?
cybersecurity.ctaDescription: Sebenzisana ne-Oklut Technologies yokuphepha ukuze uhlole izakhiwo, usebenzise izinhlaka ze-Zero Trust, futhi uvikele amasistimu abalulekile emishini.
cybersecurity.sec1P1: Enkathini yefa le-IT yebhizinisi, ukuphepha kwakusebenza ngemfundiso ye-castle-and-moat: yonke into engaphakathi kwenethiwekhi yamahhovisi ezinkampani yayithathwa njengethembekile, kuyilapho yonke into engaphandle yayibhekwa njengengathenjwa. I-firewall yebhizinisi eyodwa ivikele amaseva angaphakathi, isizindalwazi, namakhompyutha edeskithophu.
cybersecurity.sec1P2: Ibhizinisi lanamuhla selikhule kunezindonga zomzimba. Imisebenzi eminingi ihlala ezindaweni ezinamafu amaningi (i-AWS, i-Azure, i-GCP), abasebenzi bafinyelela izinhlelo zokusebenza zebhizinisi besuka ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, futhi ama-API ahlala eshintshana ngedatha yokusebenza ebucayi nabahlinzeki bezokuthutha bangaphandle, izikhungo zezezimali, nabathengisi be-SaaS.
cybersecurity.sec1P3: Ngenkathi lokhu kuxhumana okuphezulu kushayela amandla amakhulu ebhizinisi, kunweba kakhulu indawo yokuhlasela kwebhizinisi. Yonke indawo yokugcina ye-API, ithokheni kamazisi, idivayisi yeselula exhunyiwe, nokuhlanganiswa kwe-SaaS kumelela i-vector enamandla yokuchayeka. Ukuvikelwa kwebhizinisi kwangempela kudinga ukugudluka kusukela ekuvikelweni okusekelwe kupherimitha kuya ekuqiniseni i-inthanethi okusebenzayo, ekugcineni ukuya ekupheleni.

sec2Cards.title: Ukutholwa Kosongo
sec2Cards.desc: Ubuhlakani bokusiza ukufunda ngomshini obuqapha amaphethini enethiwekhi angavamile, ukuhlukumeza kokuqinisekisa, nokuba sengozini kwezinsuku eziyiziro ngesikhathi sangempela.

sec2Cards.title: Ukuqapha Ezokuphepha
sec2Cards.desc: I-Centralised Security Operations Center (SOC) imicimbi ehlotshaniswa ne-telemetry kuwo wonke amaseva, amaqoqo eziqukathi, abahlinzeki bomazisi, namaphoyinti okugcina.

sec2Cards.title: Ukuphathwa Kobungozi
sec2Cards.desc: Ukuskena okuqhubekayo kokuba sengozini okuzenzakalelayo kuyo yonke ingqalasizinda, amaqoqo ekhodi yomthombo, namarejistri weziqukathi ukuze kulungiswe ubuthakathaka ngokuqhubekayo.

sec2Cards.title: Ukuvikelwa Kwedatha
sec2Cards.desc: Ukubethela okuqinile kwezokuthutha (TLS 1.3) nasendaweni yokuphumula (AES-256), eduze nokulawulwa kokuvimbela ukulahleka kwedatha (i-DLP) ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuvuza kwempahla yengqondo.

cybersecurity.sec3P1: Ukuvikela izimpahla zebhizinisi kudinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke ubunikazi—kungakhathaliseki ukuthi isikhulu esingumuntu, usonkontileka wangaphandle, noma i-akhawunti yesevisi yesofthiwe ezimele—kugunyazwe ukugunyazwa kwezinsiza ezifinyelela ngqo.

sec3List.text: Ukungena Okukodwa (SSO) kanye namazinga kamazisi ahlanganisiwe asusa izitolo zamaphasiwedi ahlukene kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza.
Okhiye behadiwe be-FIDO2 abangazweli kubugebengu kanye nezinselele ezisekelwe engcupheni zesimo semisebenzi yokulawula ebucayi.
Izilawuli zokufinyelela ezisekelwe ku-Fine-grained Role-based (RBAC) kanye Nesibaluli (ABAC) eziphoqelelwa ku-API nakumaleveli esizindalwazi.
Ukunikeza ukufinyelela kwesikhashana, okufika ngesikhathi (i-JIT) okuphelelwa yisikhathi ngokuzenzakalelayo lapho imisebenzi yokuqondisa iphela.

cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveLead: Ekwakheni kweZero Trust, ukwethembana okugcwele okusekelwe endaweni yenethiwekhi kuhlakazwa ngokuphelele. Konke okwenziwayo, umbuzo wesizindalwazi, nokungena ngemvume komsebenzisi kufanele kuqhubeke kufakazele ukuba semthethweni kwakho:

cloudSecurityCards.title: Isibopho Esabiwe
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Ukubusa okucacile okuhlukanisa ukuvikeleka kwengqalasizinda ephathekayo yomhlinzeki wamafu nomsebenzi webhizinisi wokubethela idatha, izinqubomgomo ze-IAM, nekhodi yohlelo lokusebenza.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Ingqalasizinda njengeKhodi (IaC)
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Izilungiselelo zamafu ezingaguquki, ezifundekayo eziphathwa ngekhodi. Izikena ezizenzakalelayo zenqubomgomo njengekhodi zivimba ukungalungiseki kahle namabhakede aveziwe ngaphambi kokusetshenziswa.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Isiqukathi Nokuphepha kwe-Kubernetes
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Izikhathi zokusebenza zesiqukathi esiqinile, ukubhaliswa kwezithombe ezisayiniwe, ukuhlukaniswa okuncane kwenethiwekhi, nokuphathwa okuyimfihlo okuzenzakalelayo okugcina izifakazelo zingekho kumakhosombe omthombo.

cloudModernization.title: Ukwenza Izicelo Zefa Zesimanje Zefu
cloudModernization.subtitle: Hlola indlela engokoqobo yokuhlola, ukwenza kube yisimanjemanje kanye nokuhambisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zefa ziye ezakhiweni zamafu ezingaka, ezivikelekile.
cloudModernization.imageCaption: I-Enterprise Technology Perspective — I-Cloud-Native Re-platforming & Containerization

modernizationApproaches.title: Bamba kabusha (Lift & Shift)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Ukushintsha imithwalo yomsebenzi ukufiphaza imishini ebonakalayo ngokushesha ngokuguqulwa kwamakhodi amancane.

modernizationApproaches.title: I-Replatform (Lift & Shape Kabusha)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Thuthukisa izinhlaka zesikhathi sokusebenza, sebenzisa imininingo egciniwe yamafu ephethwe, futhi wenze lula ukusebenza.

modernizationApproaches.title: I-Refactor (I-Cloud-Native Rebuild)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Susa ukwakha ama-monoliths abe ama-microservices afakwe esitsheni kanye nama-API angenasiphakeli aqhutshwa umcimbi.

modernizationApproaches.title: Faka esikhundleni (I-SaaS Modernization)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Yeka amasistimu amafa angasebenzi ukuze avune isofthiwe yamafu yebhizinisi eyakhelwe inhloso.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Ukuhlolwa Kwefa
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Imephu yokuncika okuzenzakalelayo, ukufakwa kwekhathalogi yezikweletu zobuchwepheshe, kanye namaphuzu okulungela ifu.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: I-Target Architecture
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Amapulani we-modular microservice, ama-topology esiqukathi, nezifanekiso ze-IaC ezizenzakalelayo.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Ukufuduka Kwezigaba
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Ukukhishwa kwe-Canary, ukuvumelanisa kwedatha yokubhala kabili, kanye namagagasi anqamulelayo we-zero-downtime cutover.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Ukuthuthukisa Amafu
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Ukuphatha izindleko okuqhubekayo, i-autoscaling telemetry, kanye nokubuyekezwa kokusebenza kwe-FinOps.

Ukubonakala okuthuthukisiwe kwesikhathi sangempela ekusebenzeni kohlelo lokusebenza nasekusetshenzisweni kwemali kwamafu
landscapeAssessmentPoints: Ukwenza imephu ukuncika okuyinkimbinkimbi phakathi kwezinhlelo zokusebenza kanye nokuhlehla kokuvumelanisa idatha
Ukuhlonza ukucushwa kwemvelo okunekhodi eqinile kanye nezikimu zesizindalwazi sobunikazi
Ukuhlola ukuthotshelwa kwemithetho kanye nezithiyo zokugunyazwa kwedatha endaweni ngayinye

cloudModernization.sec1Subtext: Ama-monoliths aguga acindezela isivinini sokusungula izinto ezintsha, andise ubungozi bokusebenza, futhi andise izindleko zokunakekelwa kwengqalasizinda.
cloudModernization.sec2Subtext: Ukutholwa kwezakhiwo okuqinile ukuze kumephu ukuncika kwedatha, izinguqulo zesofthiwe, ne-ROI yesimanje ngaphambi kokuthutha.
cloudModernization.sec3Subtext: Ukukhetha iphethini yokuthutha efanele yomthwalo ngamunye womsebenzi: ukubamba kabusha, ukulungisa kabusha, ukwenza kabusha, noma ukumiselela.
cloudModernization.sec4Subtext: Ukuklama ama-microservices aqinile, imininingwane egciniwe ephethwe, namapayipi okuphakela ngokuzenzakalelayo afanele ukukala okuphezulu.
cloudModernization.sec5Subtext: Ukusebenza okuphawulekayo, ukuncishiswa kwezindleko, kanye nezabelo ezithembekile ezivulwe yi-cloud-native transformation.
cloudModernization.ctaHeading: Ukulungele Ukwenza Izicelo Zefa Lakho Zesimanje Zefu?
cloudModernization.ctaDescription: Uzakwethu nabaklami befu be-Oklut Technologies ukuze bahlole ukuncika, bakhe imephu yemigwaqo yokufuduka, futhi baguqule amasistimu akho ngokuphepha.
cloudModernization.sec1P1: Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibalulekile ezakhiwe eminyakeni eyishumi edlule zisangenisa izigidigidi zemali yebhizinisi, kodwa ukuqina kwazo kwezakhiwo kudala ubungozi obukhulayo bokusebenza.
cloudModernization.sec1P2: Yonke ibhizinisi ibhekene nokungezwani phakathi kokuzinza nokwenza kube yisimanjemanje. Amasistimu amafa aklanyelwe ukuqina, futhi asebenze ngokwethembeka iminyaka. Kodwa-ke, njengoba izidingo zebhizinisi zishesha, lezi zakhiwo eziguga zihlangabezana nemikhawulo yesakhiwo:

sec1List.text: Izisekelo zekhodi ze-Monolithic ezakhelwe phezu kwezinhlaka ezehlisiwe ezinamathalente anciphayo atholakalayo ukuze alungiswe.
Izingxenye ezihlanganiswe ngokuqinile lapho ukushintsha isici esisodwa kubeka engcupheni yokwephula amamojula okusebenza angahlobene.
Imikhawulo yokukala eqondile edinga ukuthengwa kwezingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha zobunikazi ezibizayo ukuze kusingathwe ukukhuphuka kwethrafikhi kwesizini.
Ukungakwazi ukusebenzisana kahle nezinhlelo zokusebenza zeselula zesimanje, izingosi zekhasimende, noma ama-API ozakwethu ngaphandle kwemibhalo yeqoqo entekenteke.
Imijikelezo yokuphila yegumbi lesiphakeli esiphathekayo, ukuba sengozini kwekhophi yasenqolobaneni, kanye nezindleko eziphezulu zokusebenza zamandla/zokupholisa.

cloudModernization.sec2P1: Uhambo lwesimanjemanje luqala ngokuthola ukucaca okuphelele kulo lonke ifa elikhona:

sec2List.text: Ihlela yonke imisebenzi esebenzayo, amamojula angokwezifiso, imibhalo engemuva, namaphakheji omlando ezinkampani zangaphandle.
Ukwenza imephu ukuhlanganisa okuyinkimbinkimbi kwesikhathi sokusebenza, amathebula esizindalwazi okwabelwana ngawo, izingcingo zesistimu yamafayela aqondile, nezinkontileka zesevisi zangaphandle.
Ukuhlola izakhiwo zedatha, izimfuneko zobuqotho bokwenziwe, ukugcinwa kwekhophi yasenqolobaneni, nemithetho yokulawula elawulayo.
I-CPU yokuhlola, inkumbulo, ukusetshenziswa kwesitoreji, nokuphuma kwenethiwekhi ekucacisweni kwefu okuqondiswe kosayizi ongakwesokudla.
Ukuhlukanisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zibe izigaba ukuze udizayine amagagasi okufuduka aphephile, anezigaba ezinezinqubo zokubuyela emuva ezicacile.

cloudModernization.sec4P1: Izakhiwo zendawo zihlukanisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziyinhloko zibe izinsiza zemodular, ezifakwe esiqukathi ezisingathwa ezinkundleni zamafu ezinwebekayo (ezifana ne-Kubernetes noma izikhathi zokugijima ezingenasiphakeli eziphethwe).
cloudModernization.sec4P2: Ngokusungula amapayipi wokuphakela e-CI/CD azenzakalelayo, ama-cutovers azenzakalelayo aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nengqalasizinda njengekhodi, ukuthunyelwa kushintsha kusuka emicimbini yangezimpelaviki ekhathazayo ibe yizinqubo zansuku zonke ezingenamthungo.
cloudModernization.sec4P3: Ikhompyutha ene-elastic ikhula ngokuzenzakalelayo ngesikhathi sokwanda kwesidingo futhi yehlise ngesikhathi sokupholisa, isusa izindleko zensiza engasebenzi kuyilapho iqinisekisa izikhathi zokuphendula zesekhondi elincane kubasebenzisi bomhlaba.
